description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainLog operation to query the download URLs of raw access logs for a specified domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainLog查询指定域名的原始访问日志的下载地址
name: DescribeDcdnDomainLog

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name that you want to query. You can query only one domain name at a time.
parameters.description_zh: 待查询的加速域名，只支持查询单个域名。
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name that you want to query. You can query only one domain name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的加速域名，只支持查询单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.description_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

The value must be between **1** and **1000**. The default value is **300**.
parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

The value must be between **1** and **1000**. The default value is **300**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en:
The page number to return. Valid values are integers greater than **0**.

Default value: **1**.
parameters.description_zh:
取得第几页，取值范围：大于**1**的任意整数。

默认值为**1**。
parameters.help_en:
The page number to return. Valid values are integers greater than **0**.

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh:
获取日志起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

parameters.description_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.
parameters.description_zh:

> 结束时间需大于起始时间。
